Prepare for new unspeakable terrors this Halloween! 🎃

"The Cult of Tsathoggua" major free update is AVAILABLE NOW on XBOX Series X|S.

Face Tsathoggua, a grotesque Great Old One lurking deep within the cursed continent. Will you survive the descent, or let the madness consume you?

UPDATE FEATURES:
🐸 New map: Brave the dark lair of the amphibian deity, Tsathoggua.
💎 Revamped Treasure Shrines: Higher risks! Stealing loot can now trigger traps or summon monsters.

⚔️ New arsenal: New weapons and occult items to fight back or pit monsters against each other.

📈 Level cap 70: Spend skill points to unlock bleeding resistance, extra stamina, and speed.

👁️ New sanity effects: Watch your mind... your eyes will start playing tricks on you.

Available now on XBOX Series X|S.
